warm_up:
Activation & Mobilisation Drills:
1 round
Warm Up
10 Scap Push Ups
10 scap Pull ups
10 x Inch Worms
10 I-Y-T-W
10 Leg Raise holding rig
Wrist Mobilisation
Banded Pull Aparts x 10
5 x PVC Pipe Around the world
gymnastics:
EMOM x 4
5 Hollow to Arch Rolls
Maintain tension - point fingers and toes the whole time.
Pull Up Progression
EMOM x 3
10 x Beat Swing
EMOM x 3
Jump Into Hollow/Arch x 10
EMOM x 3
Bigger Beat Swing - Lean Back to begin Pull
Big Hip Pop
Singles - Focus on Pulling into the bar and pushing away
EMOM x 5
Jumping C2B - Pause at the bar and slow lower
- Maintain Hollow - Pull Ribs into hips
HSW Progression
5 mins - Handstand Kick Up 10 Reps (33:00)
Beginners - Start from a Pike - Pop up with 1 foot only
Aim for soft feet onto wall
5 mins - Nose & toes to wall - Keep in a hollow (38:00)
Accumulate 2 mins total
5 mins - Nose & toes Shoulder taps - (40:00)
Shift Weight between hands
5 mins - HSW Attempts or stay with a prior progression (45:00-50:00)

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today heavily taxes shoulders, lats, and core via gymnastics and HSW. Build opposing muscle groups without CNS overlap.
suggested_exercises: Leg Press or Bulgarian Split Squads 3x8-10
Tricep Pushdowns or Close-Grip Bench Press 3x10-12
